description: A relative overflow-hidden wrapper around an or a RiveCanvas. There is usually NO aspect-ratio wrapper: the asset’s INTRINSIC ratio sets the section height, so width/height attributes are load-bearing, not decorative.
notes: Source HEIFs were transcoded to WebP because HEIF does not decode in browsers; Chromium reports naturalWidth/Height as 0,0 for the HEIF, so the intrinsic size must be supplied explicitly.
